meaning: unclear, not clearly written or explained

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when information, meaning, or a definition is not clear.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 se2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2

english.note: Use this all-purpose expression when something is visually indistinct or its facts and status are unclear, rather than when it is specifically hard to understand.

exampleSentences.english: The information on this old map is obscure.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張舊地圖上面嘅資料唔清楚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 gau6 dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 ge3 zi1 liu2 m4 cing1 co2

english.note: Use this when information, an explanation, or a distinction is unclear rather than simply difficult.

exampleSentences.english: Your explanation is confusing, so I don't know what you mean.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你講得唔清楚，我唔知你想點。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 dim2
